name: GitHub Copilot
description: AI pair programmer that helps you write code faster with contextual suggestions.
longDescription: GitHub Copilot is an AI-powered coding assistant that integrates directly into your IDE. It provides real-time code suggestions, whole-function completions, and natural language-to-code translation. Built on OpenAI Codex models and fine-tuned on billions of lines of public code, it supports dozens of languages and frameworks.
strengths: Deep IDE integration (VS Code, JetBrains, Neovim)
limitations: Less effective on very niche frameworks

codeSnippets.label: Python
codeSnippets.code:
import openai

client = openai.OpenAI(
    base_url="https://models.inference.ai.azure.com",
    api_key="YOUR_GITHUB_TOKEN"
)
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="gpt-4o",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Write a Python function to sort a list"}]
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)
